query:
UPDATE discovery_entries SET state=CASE WHEN state='withdrawn' OR $3 THEN 'withdrawn' ELSE 'denied' END,
        revision=revision+1,title=NULL,summary=NULL,language=NULL,published_at=NULL,sensitive=false,
        invalidation_reason=$4,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
        WHERE canonical_uri=$1 AND actor_uri=$2 AND kind='post'
